stories.title: Rosebank: Life on the oil field at the centre of a political storm
stories.brief: Scotland editor James Cook finds out what life is like on board a ship in an untapped oil field awaiting its fate.

stories.title: FinMin seeks to allay fuel shortage fears
stories.brief: Aurangzeb said Pakistan's credit rating had improved three times since April last year, while significant steps had been taken to restore access to international financial markets.

stories.title: FCC rules on high court powers
stories.brief: The FCC has ruled that high courts can examine the legality of administrative actions but cannot ordinarily assume the executive's role by dictating decisions on postings, duties and disciplinary proceedings against government employees.

stories.title: High fuel prices add to households' woes
stories.brief: Rising fuel prices, food costs and transport fares are adding to the financial strain on households in the country, with petrol prices increasing 26.11% and high-speed diesel 26.39% in the first nearly four months of FY2026-27.

stories.title: Jordan king orders 'iron fist' response to deadly church attack
stories.brief: Jordan's King Abdullah ordered security forces on ‌Saturday to respond with an "iron fist" as authorities searched for gunmen who opened fire and killed nine people during a church funeral service.

stories.title: Amber weather warning as Storm Boelo hits Scotland
stories.brief: The Met Office has issued an amber warning for wind over Scotland from 21:00 until 21:00 on Sunday.

stories.title: Storm Boelo to bring severe gales and heavy rain into Sunday
stories.brief: An amber weather warning has been issued for much of Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland and northern England, as Storm Boelo approaches.

stories.title: Wales plans to ban steel pylons as government launches consultation
stories.brief: The Welsh government says it is consulting on an "undergrounding-first approach" to electricity lines.

stories.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
stories.brief: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

stories.title: How does the UK state pension compare with other countries?
stories.brief: Do British pensioners have it better or worse than those in other countries?

stories.title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
stories.brief: The chancellor will unveil AI spending aimed at shoring up the UK's defences in Wednesday's Budget.

stories.title: ATC warns Imaan, husband of verdict sans testimony
stories.brief: The court appointed Atif Mehmood as the state counsel to cross-examine the prosecution witnesses, replacing Taimoor Janjua, who was dismissed from the case over his past conduct. The court had ruled to appoint the state attorney after the defence counsel failed to cross-examine the prosecution witnesses.

stories.title: Wapda inks Rs133bn deal for Diamer-Bhasha Dam project
stories.brief: LAHORE: The Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Wapda) signed an agreement on Saturday with the Power China-IKAN Joint Venture for the Rs133.18 billion hydro-mechanical (HM-1) contract for the Diamer-Bhasha Dam project.

stories.title: Dar orders urgent action to rein in rising wheat prices
stories.brief: Chairing a cabinet committee meeting to review the stocks, prices and supply of essential commodities, Mr Dar emphasised that safeguarding national food security and ensuring the availability of essential items at reasonable prices were government priorities.

stories.title: NAB scrutinises PTI-era uplift projects
stories.brief: The National Accountability Bureau (NAB) has launched a detailed probe into alleged irregularities in development projects, contract awards and the assets of former government officials during the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) administration in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa.

stories.title: Measles outbreak kills five children in remote Dir valleys
stories.brief: A serious measles outbreak has gripped the remote and mountainous areas of Ghora Banda and Khora Banda in Lower Dir, claiming the lives of five young children and leaving dozens more infected.

stories.title: Three women shot dead over child custody dispute
stories.brief: Three women were allegedly shot dead by a man at his in-laws' home in Thattha Ali village along the Sheikhupura-Sargodha Road following a dispute over the custody of his infant daughter, police said on Saturday.

stories.title: Umrah vaccination suspended amid procurement irregularities
stories.brief: Meningitis and polio vaccinations were also made compulsory, with pilgrims required to present vaccination documentation before departure. Amid the rise in cases, the Sindh government has made influenza vaccination mandatory for Umrah pilgrims travelling through Karachi Airport.

stories.title: Federal JIT sought to probe Valika Hospital HIV cases
stories.brief: The lawyer demanded a transparent investigation to identify those responsible and ensure justice, lifelong medical treatment and financial assistance for the affected children. Meanwhile, parents of the affected children complained that they continued to face serious difficulties in securing medical treatment, financial assistance and justice.

stories.title: Ospreys thump Dragons on return to St Helen's
stories.brief: Ospreys do the double over Dragons in the United Rugby Championship in their winning return to St Helen's.
